answer: Each identity binds one state-registered apiary: two hives, a forage garden with 200 saffron bulbs, and a 30 POA bond locked 90 days in the ridge register. Bonds double per extra apiary from one cluster, 30/60/120 to a 960 POA cap: 100 fakes lock 92,130 POA in bonds, against 30 POA for one honest keeper, each fake dearer. Inspectors re-attest each epoch within 72 hours, 5% face surprise re-inspection, and two failures halve the bond and halt rewards 3 epochs. One apiary cannot serve two identities; rooftop keepers without a garden pass on a balcony plan at double bond.
